title_en: Curt Pires Takes on Hollywood and AI in Content, a Razor-Sharp New Image Comics Sci-Fi Thriller Arriving in February 2027
summary_en: IGN can exclusively reveal a new preview of the Image Comics graphic novel Content, which spoofs our current climate of mindless content consumption and rampant AI use.
body_en:
Curt Pires has built up a huge fan following in the comic book scene for his inventive work on books like the Star Wars/Tarantino mash-up Galactic and the Pokémon-spoofing Creature Corps . Pires is now teaming with artist Ryan Quackenbush (Junior Baker the Righteous Faker) for a new Image Comics graphic novel called Content, and it's a book that's perfect for our current age of mindless content consumption and rampant AI use.
IGN can exclusively reveal a new preview of Content. Check it out in the slideshow gallery below, but beware of some NSFW language:
Here's Image's official summary of Content:
Content will be released in comic shops on February 17 and in bookstores on March 16. You can preorder a copy at your local comic shop .
Also hitting stores in February 2027 are Batman: Reign of Assassins and a new Sabrina the Teenage Witch storyline .
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
